item.title: Pet Project: Meet Dudley
item.description: Dudley’s Second Chance Dudley was found near the Louisiana–Arkansas state line, abandoned, scared, and desperately hungry. item.title: Springhill Fire Department answers call around 12:30 p.m. Tuesday
